name: Works
overview: Scripture emphasizes that obedience to God's commandments and doing good works are integral to righteousness, as shown in Deuteronomy where observing God's commands and acting justly toward others is described as righteousness before the Lord. The Psalms encourage trusting in the Lord and actively doing good, promising provision and stability for those who do so. The prayers in Nehemiah highlight that God remembers and values the good deeds done for His house and people, affirming that faithful works are acknowledged by God. Additionally, Job's compassion for those in trouble exemplifies the heartfelt nature of righteous actions that reflect God's character.
